reviews.title: Gigabyte Z790 Eagle AX Review
reviews.comment:
My daughter wanted me to build her a PC and I had a few extra parts laying around. I needed an affordable LGA1700 motherboard to pair with my existing parts.

Gigabytes Z790 Eagle AX checked all of the boxes at an affordable price.
-LGA1700 w/ DDR5 ATX
-PCIE 5.0 slot
-Built-in WIFI 6E
-At least 2 M.2 NVME slots
-2.5Gb LAN
-Decent amount of USB slots
-Bonus USB-C

The Motherboard was easy to install and cable management was a breeze. I would recommend this board to anyone looking for an affordable LGA1700 option.

reviews.title: Excellent budget to mid-range motherboard.
reviews.comment:
I have always used a Gigabyte motherboard from my AMD FX8320, i5 9600K, i5 12600K, to my i5 14600K. The bios is easy to navigate. The build and component quality is great. Performance is excellent maxing out my 180hz qd0oled monitor at 1440p, ultra graphics, native settings.

DO NOT USE GIGABYTE CONTROL CENTER. It will wreck your performance. Most if not all motherboard rgb software does.

The other PCIE slots are kind of useless at PCIE Gen4x1
